verses.greek: Οὐδὲν ἄρα νῦν κατάκριμα τοῖς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ·
verses.literal: No therefore now condemnation to those in Christ Jesus
verses.dgt: Therefore there is now no condemnation for those in Christ Jesus.

verses.greek: ὁ γὰρ νόμος τοῦ πνεύματος τῆς ζωῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ἠλευθέρωσέν σε ἀπὸ τοῦ νόμου τῆς ἁμαρτίας καὶ τοῦ θανάτου.
verses.literal: the For the law of the Spirit the of life in Christ Jesus has set free you from the law the of sin and the of death.
verses.dgt: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus set you free from the law of sin and death.

verses.greek: τὸ γὰρ ἀδύνατον τοῦ νόμου, ἐν ᾧ ἠσθένει διὰ τῆς σαρκός, ὁ θεὸς τὸν ἑαυτοῦ υἱὸν πέμψας ἐν ὁμοιώματι σαρκὸς ἁμαρτίας καὶ περὶ ἁμαρτίας κατέκρινε τὴν ἁμαρτίαν ἐν τῇ σαρκί,
verses.literal: the For powerless being the law in that it was weak through the flesh the God the His own Son having sent in likeness of flesh of sin and for sin condemned the sin in the flesh
verses.dgt: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God did: sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and concerning sin, he condemned sin in the flesh,

verses.greek: ἵνα τὸ δικαίωμα τοῦ νόμου πληρωθῇ ἐν ἡμῖν τοῖς μὴ κατὰ σάρκα περιπατοῦσιν ἀλλὰ κατὰ πνεῦμα·
verses.literal: so that the righteousness of the law may be fulfilled in us the not according to the flesh walking but according to the Spirit.
verses.dgt: so that the righteous requirement of the law might be fulfilled in us who walk not according to flesh but according to Spirit.

verses.greek: οἱ γὰρ κατὰ σάρκα ὄντες τὰ τῆς σαρκὸς φρονοῦσιν, οἱ δὲ κατὰ πνεῦμα τὰ τοῦ πνεύματος.
verses.literal: Those for according to flesh being the things of the flesh mind those however according to Spirit the things of the Spirit.
verses.dgt: For those who are according to flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those according to Spirit on the things of the Spirit.

verses.greek: τὸ γὰρ φρόνημα τῆς σαρκὸς θάνατος, τὸ δὲ φρόνημα τοῦ πνεύματος ζωὴ καὶ εἰρήνη·
verses.literal: The for mind of the flesh is death the but mind of the Spirit life and peace.
verses.dgt: For the mindset of the flesh is death, but the mindset of the Spirit is life and peace.

verses.greek: διότι τὸ φρόνημα τῆς σαρκὸς ἔχθρα εἰς θεόν, τῷ γὰρ νόμῳ τοῦ θεοῦ οὐχ ὑποτάσσεται, οὐδὲ γὰρ δύναται·
verses.literal: because the mind of the flesh is hostility toward God the for the law the of God not it is subject nor even for can it be
verses.dgt: Because the mindset of the flesh is hostility toward God, for it does not submit to the law of God, nor indeed can it.

verses.greek: οἱ δὲ ἐν σαρκὶ ὄντες θεῷ ἀρέσαι οὐ δύνανται.
verses.literal: Those now in flesh being God to please not are able
verses.dgt: And those who are in flesh cannot please God.

verses.greek: Ὑμεῖς δὲ οὐκ ἐστὲ ἐν σαρκὶ ἀλλὰ ἐν πνεύματι, εἴπερ πνεῦμα θεοῦ οἰκεῖ ἐν ὑμῖν. εἰ δέ τις πνεῦμα Χριστοῦ οὐκ ἔχει, οὗτος οὐκ ἔστιν αὐτοῦ.
verses.literal: You yourselves now not are in flesh but in Spirit if indeed Spirit of God dwells in you. if however anyone the Spirit of Christ not has he not is of Him.
verses.dgt: But you are not in flesh but in Spirit, if indeed the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if anyone does not have the Spirit of Christ, that person does not belong to him.

verses.greek: εἰ δὲ Χριστὸς ἐν ὑμῖν, τὸ μὲν σῶμα νεκρὸν διὰ ἁμαρτίαν, τὸ δὲ πνεῦμα ζωὴ διὰ δικαιοσύνην.
verses.literal: If now Christ is in you the indeed body is dead on account of sin the however Spirit is life on account of righteousness.
verses.dgt: But if Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.

verses.greek: εἰ δὲ τὸ πνεῦμα τοῦ ἐγείραντος τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἐκ νεκρῶν οἰκεῖ ἐν ὑμῖν, ὁ ἐγείρας ἐκ νεκρῶν Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν ζῳοποιήσει καὶ τὰ θνητὰ σώματα ὑμῶν διὰ τὸ ἐνοικοῦν αὐτοῦ πνεῦμα ἐν ὑμῖν.
verses.literal: If now the Spirit of the One having raised up the Jesus out from the dead dwells in you the One having raised up out from the dead Christ Jesus will give life also to the mortal bodies of you on account of the ἐνοικοῦν of His πνεῦμα in you.
verses.dgt: And if the Spirit of the one who raised Jesus from the dead dwells in you, the one who raised Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit dwelling in you.

verses.greek: Ἄρα οὖν, ἀδελφοί, ὀφειλέται ἐσμέν, οὐ τῇ σαρκὶ τοῦ κατὰ σάρκα ζῆν,
verses.literal: So then brothers debtors we are not to the flesh the according to flesh to live
verses.dgt: So then, brothers and sisters, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live according to flesh.

verses.greek: εἰ γὰρ κατὰ σάρκα ζῆτε μέλλετε ἀποθνῄσκειν, εἰ δὲ πνεύματι τὰς πράξεις τοῦ σώματος θανατοῦτε, ζήσεσθε.
verses.literal: If for according to flesh you live you are about to die if however by the Spirit the deeds of the body you put to death you will live.
verses.dgt: For if you live according to flesh, you are about to die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the practices of the body, you will live.

verses.greek: ὅσοι γὰρ πνεύματι θεοῦ ἄγονται, οὗτοι υἱοί εἰσιν θεοῦ.
verses.literal: As many as for by the Spirit of God are led these sons are. of God
verses.dgt: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are sons of God.

verses.greek: οὐ γὰρ ἐλάβετε πνεῦμα δουλείας πάλιν εἰς φόβον, ἀλλὰ ἐλάβετε πνεῦμα υἱοθεσίας ἐν ᾧ κράζομεν· Αββα ὁ πατήρ·
verses.literal: Not for you have received a spirit of bondage again to fear but you have received the Spirit of divine adoption as sons by whom we cry Abba O Father!
verses.dgt: For you did not receive a spirit of slavery again leading to fear, but you received a Spirit of adoption, in whom we cry, “Abba, Father.”

verses.greek: αὐτὸ τὸ πνεῦμα συμμαρτυρεῖ τῷ πνεύματι ἡμῶν ὅτι ἐσμὲν τέκνα θεοῦ.
verses.literal: Himself the Spirit bears witness with the spirit of us that we are children of God.
verses.dgt: The Spirit himself bears witness with our spirit that we are children of God.

verses.greek: εἰ δὲ τέκνα, καὶ κληρονόμοι· κληρονόμοι μὲν θεοῦ, συγκληρονόμοι δὲ Χριστοῦ, εἴπερ συμπάσχομεν ἵνα καὶ συνδοξασθῶμεν.
verses.literal: If now children also heirs heirs indeed of God joint-heirs however of Christ if indeed we suffer with Him so that also we shall be glorified together.
verses.dgt: And if children, also heirs—heirs of God and fellow heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with him so that we may also be glorified with him.

verses.greek: Λογίζομαι γὰρ ὅτι οὐκ ἄξια τὰ παθήματα τοῦ νῦν καιροῦ πρὸς τὴν μέλλουσαν δόξαν ἀποκαλυφθῆναι εἰς ἡμᾶς.
verses.literal: I reckon for that not comparable the sufferings of the present time are to the coming glory to be revealed to us.
verses.dgt: For I reckon that the sufferings of the present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory about to be revealed to us.

verses.greek: ἡ γὰρ ἀποκαραδοκία τῆς κτίσεως τὴν ἀποκάλυψιν τῶν υἱῶν τοῦ θεοῦ ἀπεκδέχεται·
verses.literal: The for earnest expectation of the creation the revelation of the sons the of God awaits
verses.dgt: For the eager expectation of creation awaits the revelation of the sons of God.

verses.greek: τῇ γὰρ ματαιότητι ἡ κτίσις ὑπετάγη, οὐχ ἑκοῦσα ἀλλὰ διὰ τὸν ὑποτάξαντα, ἐφʼ ἑλπίδι
verses.literal: To the for futility the creation was subjected not willingly but because of the One having subjected it in hope
verses.dgt: For creation was subjected to futility, not willingly but because of the one who subjected it, in hope

verses.greek: ὅτι καὶ αὐτὴ ἡ κτίσις ἐλευθερωθήσεται ἀπὸ τῆς δουλείας τῆς φθορᾶς εἰς τὴν ἐλευθερίαν τῆς δόξης τῶν τέκνων τοῦ θεοῦ.
verses.literal: for also itself the creation will be set free from the bondage the of decay into the freedom of the glory of the children the of God.
verses.dgt: that creation itself also will be set free from the slavery of corruption into the freedom of the glory of the children of God.

verses.greek: οἴδαμεν γὰρ ὅτι πᾶσα ἡ κτίσις συστενάζει καὶ συνωδίνει ἄχρι τοῦ νῦν·
verses.literal: We know for that all the creation groans together and it travails together until the now
verses.dgt: For we know that all creation groans together and suffers birth pains together until now.

verses.greek: οὐ μόνον δέ, ἀλλὰ καὶ αὐτοὶ τὴν ἀπαρχὴν τοῦ πνεύματος ἔχοντες ἡμεῖς καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐν ἑαυτοῖς στενάζομεν, υἱοθεσίαν ἀπεκδεχόμενοι τὴν ἀπολύτρωσιν τοῦ σώματος ἡμῶν.
verses.literal: Not only so now but even ourselves the firstfruit of the Spirit having we ourselves also ourselves in ourselves groan divine adoption as sons awaiting the redemption of the body of us.
verses.dgt: And not only creation, but we ourselves also, having the firstfruits of the Spirit, groan within ourselves while waiting eagerly for adoption, the redemption of our body.

verses.greek: τῇ γὰρ ἐλπίδι ἐσώθημεν· ἐλπὶς δὲ βλεπομένη οὐκ ἔστιν ἐλπίς, ὃ γὰρ βλέπει τίς ἐλπίζει;
verses.literal: In this for hope we were saved hope however being seen not is hope what for sees any does he hope for it?
verses.dgt: For in hope we were saved. But hope that is seen is not hope, for who hopes for what is seen?

verses.greek: εἰ δὲ ὃ οὐ βλέπομεν ἐλπίζομεν, διʼ ὑπομονῆς ἀπεκδεχόμεθα.
verses.literal: If however what not we see we hope for in patience we await.
verses.dgt: But if we hope for what we do not see, we wait eagerly through endurance.

verses.greek: Ὡσαύτως δὲ καὶ τὸ πνεῦμα συναντιλαμβάνεται τῇ ἀσθενείᾳ ἡμῶν· τὸ γὰρ τί προσευξώμεθα καθὸ δεῖ οὐκ οἴδαμεν, ἀλλὰ αὐτὸ τὸ πνεῦμα ὑπερεντυγχάνει στεναγμοῖς ἀλαλήτοις,
verses.literal: Likewise now also the Spirit joins to help the weakness of us the for things which we may pray for as it behooves not we know but Himself the Spirit makes intercession with groanings inexpressible
verses.dgt: And likewise the Spirit also helps in our weakness. For we do not know what we should pray as we ought, but the Spirit himself intercedes with unspoken groanings.

verses.greek: ὁ δὲ ἐραυνῶν τὰς καρδίας οἶδεν τί τὸ φρόνημα τοῦ πνεύματος, ὅτι κατὰ θεὸν ἐντυγχάνει ὑπὲρ ἁγίων.
verses.literal: The One now searching the hearts knows what is the mindset of the Spirit because according to God He intercedes for the saints.
verses.dgt: And the one who searches hearts knows what the mindset of the Spirit is, because according to God he intercedes for the saints.

verses.greek: Οἴδαμεν δὲ ὅτι τοῖς ἀγαπῶσι τὸν θεὸν πάντα συνεργεῖ εἰς ἀγαθόν, τοῖς κατὰ πρόθεσιν κλητοῖς οὖσιν.
verses.literal: We know now that to those loving the God all things works together for good to those according to His purpose called being.
verses.dgt: And we know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to purpose.

verses.greek: ὅτι οὓς προέγνω, καὶ προώρισεν συμμόρφους τῆς εἰκόνος τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ, εἰς τὸ εἶναι αὐτὸν πρωτότοκον ἐν πολλοῖς ἀδελφοῖς·
verses.literal: For those whom He foreknew also He predestined to be conformed to the image of the Son of Him for the to be Him firstborn among many brothers
verses.dgt: Because those whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, so that he would be firstborn among many brothers and sisters.

verses.greek: οὓς δὲ προώρισεν, τούτους καὶ ἐκάλεσεν· καὶ οὓς ἐκάλεσεν, τούτους καὶ ἐδικαίωσεν· οὓς δὲ ἐδικαίωσεν, τούτους καὶ ἐδόξασεν.
verses.literal: Those whom then He predestined these also He called and whom He called these also He justified whom then He justified these also He glorified.
verses.dgt: And those whom he predestined, these he also called; and those whom he called, these he also justified; and those whom he justified, these he also glorified.

verses.greek: Τί οὖν ἐροῦμεν πρὸς ταῦτα; εἰ ὁ θεὸς ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν, τίς καθʼ ἡμῶν;
verses.literal: What then will we say to these things? If the God is for us who can be against us?
verses.dgt: What then shall we say to these things? If God is for us, who is against us?

verses.greek: ὅς γε τοῦ ἰδίου υἱοῦ οὐκ ἐφείσατο, ἀλλὰ ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν πάντων παρέδωκεν αὐτόν, πῶς οὐχὶ καὶ σὺν αὐτῷ τὰ πάντα ἡμῖν χαρίσεται;
verses.literal: He who indeed the his own Son not spared but for us all gave up Him how surely also with Him the things all us will He grant?
verses.dgt: He who did not spare his own Son but handed him over for us all, how will he not also, with him, graciously give us all things?

verses.greek: τίς ἐγκαλέσει κατὰ ἐκλεκτῶν θεοῦ; θεὸς ὁ δικαιῶν·
verses.literal: Who will bring an accusation against the elect of God? God is who is justifying
verses.dgt: Who will bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? God is the one who justifies.

verses.greek: τίς ὁ κατακρινῶν; Χριστὸς ὁ ἀποθανών, μᾶλλον δὲ ἐγερθείς, ὅς καί ἐστιν ἐν δεξιᾷ τοῦ θεοῦ, ὃς καὶ ἐντυγχάνει ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν·
verses.literal: Who is the one condemning? For it is Christ the one having died rather now having been raised up who also is at the right hand the of God who and is interceding for us.
verses.dgt: Who is the one who condemns? Christ is the one who died, and more than that was raised, who also is at the right hand of God, who also intercedes for us.

verses.greek: τίς ἡμᾶς χωρίσει ἀπὸ τῆς ἀγάπης τοῦ Χριστοῦ; θλῖψις ἢ στενοχωρία ἢ διωγμὸς ἢ λιμὸς ἢ γυμνότης ἢ κίνδυνος ἢ μάχαιρα;
verses.literal: Who us will separate from the love the of Christ? Tribulation or distress or persecution or famine or nakedness or danger or sword?
verses.dgt: Who will separate us from the love of Christ? Affliction, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or danger, or sword?

verses.greek: καθὼς γέγραπται ὅτι Ἕνεκεν σοῦ θανατούμεθα ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν, ἐλογίσθημεν ὡς πρόβατα σφαγῆς.
verses.literal: Even as it has been written that For the sake of you we face death all the day we were regarded as sheep of slaughter.
verses.dgt: Just as it is written, “For your sake we are being put to death all day long; we were counted as sheep for slaughter.”

verses.greek: ἀλλʼ ἐν τούτοις πᾶσιν ὑπερνικῶμεν διὰ τοῦ ἀγαπήσαντος ἡμᾶς.
verses.literal: But in these things all we more than conquer through the One who having loved us
verses.dgt: But in all these things we overwhelmingly conquer through the one who loved us.

verses.greek: πέπεισμαι γὰρ ὅτι οὔτε θάνατος οὔτε ζωὴ οὔτε ἄγγελοι οὔτε ἀρχαὶ οὔτε ἐνεστῶτα οὔτε μέλλοντα οὔτε δυνάμεις
verses.literal: I have been persuaded for that neither death nor life nor angels nor principalities nor things being present nor things to come nor powers
verses.dgt: For I am convinced that neither death nor life, nor angels nor rulers, nor things present nor things to come, nor powers,

verses.greek: οὔτε ὕψωμα οὔτε βάθος οὔτε τις κτίσις ἑτέρα δυνήσεται ἡμᾶς χωρίσαι ἀπὸ τῆς ἀγάπης τοῦ θεοῦ τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ τῷ κυρίῳ ἡμῶν.
verses.literal: nor height nor depth nor any created thing other will be able us to separate from the love the of God the in Christ Jesus the Lord of us.
verses.dgt: nor height nor depth nor any other creation will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
